_note: Pop-up booth days. A customer invites domochi; if you accept, the next day is this event: more customers (customersMultiplier), arriving faster (spawnFactor < 1 = shorter gaps), tipping more (tipMultiplier). No morning deliveries on event days. Names are generic (a real event or venue needs their OK first).

events.name: a birthday party
events.invite: my daughter's birthday party is tomorrow. would domochi pop up?

events.invite: we're tailgating before the game tomorrow. you HAVE to bring the donuts!
